verdict.rationale: Honeybadger can be driven non-interactively for pipeline automation. Its official CLI provides `honeybadger deploy` to record deployments and `honeybadger exec` to wrap commands and report non-zero exits. HTTP APIs cover deploy notifications, source-map uploads, exception reporting and fault/project retrieval, and a community user credits the Capistrano deploy integration. Missing for 10: explicit CI-specific guides (e.g., GitHub Actions/GitLab CI examples), a language-agnostic CLI beyond the Ruby gem, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
